name: Mobis Parts America PDC - Jamesburg NJ

fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint. The NE truck court is open paved area; the access road from Cranbury South River Rd connects directly into the court with no perimeter fence (confirmed z20/z21 satellite).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure anywhere at the building or court entrance.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Separate row of drop trailers (no tractors) along the NE edge of the court, beyond the active dock-door staging.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~32 dock doors along the single NE building face (band 25-50).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Drop trailers parked in the NE court plus trailers staged at dock doors; estimate 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The dock court approach is long and wide enough to hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Honest overhead estimate of court trailer capacity.
